A monumental weathered red-brick split gate of medieval Dhaha at sunset. Kirana and the spear guard face FOUR carved stone dials; a water jug and bronze mirror nearby, mossed reliefs, high watchtower. No readable letters.

doubt.title: Pertemuan dengan Ki Samar
doubt.subject: Kirana is a young Indonesian university woman, long black high ponytail, blue-and-white varsity jacket over white shirt, dark trousers, white sneakers, tan backpack. Ki Samar appears out of thin violet mist beneath the Dhaha brick gateway at sunset and calmly questions Kirana. Her oil lamp holds a small warm pool of light between them, fading gold sky and manuscript motes. Philosophical tension, not combat.

The princess gestures kindly toward a dawn-lit portal, white-gold cloth, batik and warm light.

serat-asih.title: Ingatan Asih
serat-asih.subject: Mbok Rondo is an elderly Javanese woman with a grey bun, cream shoulder shawl, brown top and brown-gold batik sarong, kind lined face. Historical flashback, NO MODERN KIRANA: Mbok Rondo finds a tiny glowing golden snail beside a green rice-field stream and carefully lifts it into her palms. At this moment the princess IS the snail: exactly ONE HUMAN, elderly Mbok, and no human princess, ghost princess or reflection. Humble bamboo hut beyond, gentle late afternoon warmth, kindness shown through her action.
